exercises.subtitle: Leg extension drop set of death

exercises.subtitle: One arm pulldown with banded iso hold

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Barbell squat drop set of death

exercises.subtitle: Leg raise and incline sit up combo

exercises.title: Abs
exercises.subtitle: Leg raise and incline sit up combo

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Seated leg curls
exercises.body: Once you are warmed up here, I want 5 sets of 8. On all 5 sets I want someone to apply some eccentric pressure for you to resist as you lower the weight. If you are on your own, just do a 4 second count on the way down. 5 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Squat
exercises.body: I would love for you to use a safety squat bar this week if you have one. If not, that is ok, just use a regular bar. Do sets of 8 up until you can barely get 8, and as always, lower slowly and then blast the weight up. We will count this as 3 work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Hack squat
exercises.body: Do 4 sets of 8 here. These sets should all be tough. I want these done rest pause style, so stop at the bottom for a second and drive the weight up. If you don't have a good hack squat, replace with front squats. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Leg extension
exercises.body: On these, just like we did with your leg curls, I want someone to apply some extra pressure while you are lowering the weight only. Do 4 sets of 8 like this. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Dumbell stiff legged deadlift
exercises.body: Let's finish up with 4 sets of 10 here coming up all the way and flexing your glutes on each rep. 3 total work set.

exercises.title: Calves
exercises.subtitle: Standing raises
exercises.body: We are doing medium reps this week. I want 6 sets of 15. 6 total work set.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Flat dumbell press
exercises.body: Normally we work up to our heaviest set and stop. Today I want you to do something a little different. I want you to work up to the set, and stay there for 4 sets. The target is 8 reps per set, but if you find that you lose a rep or two as you go, that's ok, it's just fatigue from working hard with heavy weight. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Incline barbell press
exercises.body: Let's take the reps even higher today on these! Do 3 sets of 12. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Machine press
exercises.body: On these I want you to do 4 sets of 8. I want you to take these to 3/4 lockout. Your triceps will probably be a little fried from the previous two exercises, so let's keep the tension on the chest. 4 total work set.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Machine flyes
exercises.body: Do 4 hard sets of 8 here. Flex hard on every rep! 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Shoulders
exercises.subtitle: Seated dumbell side laterals
exercises.body: Do 3 sets of 10 here. Bring the dumbells up to eye level. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Shoulders
exercises.subtitle: Bent over dumbell flyes
exercises.body: You can stay seated if you like as we transition to your rear delts. Do 3 sets of 15 here. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Shoulders
exercises.subtitle: Wide grip upright rows
exercises.body: Do these nice and slow and only come up to the bottom of your chest. Do not go higher than that. Do 3 sets of 12 here. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Meadows row
exercises.body: We are going to stick with these this week, but bump the reps up to 10. Once you find the weight for a tough 10, stick with it and do 4 sets. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Low cable row
exercises.body: Use a close grip attachment on these. Pull the attachment into your low abs, and flex your lats as hard as you can. Do 4 sets of 8 here. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Banded pullovers
exercises.body: Time to get back to these! Do 4 sets of 10 here using a band. 4 total work set.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Supported chest row
exercises.body: Use a machine that allows you to place your chest on the pad. Use a pronated grip as we are going to target upper back now. Do 4 sets of 10. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Banded hyperextensions
exercises.body: If your lower back is strong enough, I would like for you to use bands here. You could also just hold weight in your arms as you do these, but I prefer the band as it applies the most pressure as you approach the peak contraction. Do 4 sets of 10. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Abs
exercises.subtitle: Leg raise and incline sit up combo
exercises.body: Adding a round this week. Do 4 rounds to failure here. 8 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Leg extensions
exercises.body: Do 6 sets of 15 here. I want your quads smoking and ready for the next exercise. 6 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Leg press ascending set
exercises.body: You are going to start with 1 plate per side, and do 8 reps. After every 8 reps you add a plate and do it again. You keep going until you can barely get your 8. Ideally you have a workout partner who can slap the weight on for you. 1 total work set.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Leg press drop set
exercises.body: Since we have weight on here, why not now do a drop set. Start at 8, and work in reverse. You will have to take 2 plates off on the first drop though, or you won't be able to get many reps. Just do what you can as you keep dropping the weight. 1 total work set.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Lying leg curls
exercises.body: Do 3 sets of 15 to wrap up for the day. This is a short but painful day! 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Biceps
exercises.subtitle: EZ bar reverse curls
exercises.body: Do 4 sets of 12 here to get you started. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Biceps
exercises.subtitle: Hammer curls
exercises.body: To continue the emphasis on brachialis, we do these. Do 4 sets of 12. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Biceps
exercises.subtitle: Dumbell preacher curl
exercises.body: I want 3 sets of 8 on here today. Lower the dumbell very slow, 3 seconds, before curling back up. On your 4th set, I want you to do a drop set. Drop 2 times. Shoot for 8 reps roughly per drop. 4 total work set.

exercises.title: Triceps
exercises.subtitle: Tricep pushdowns
exercises.body: We are doing the single handle version again. Do 4 sets of 20 to start. We are going to jack the reps up, and blow your triceps up. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Triceps
exercises.subtitle: Bent over tricep extensions
exercises.body: Do 4 sets of 20 with the single handles here too! 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Triceps
exercises.subtitle: Dip machine
exercises.body: Do 3 sets of 8 here, and then do a big drop set. I want 8, and then 2 more drops where you shoot for another 8 or so reps each time. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Abs
exercises.subtitle: Leg raises
exercises.body: Do 5 sets to failure here. 5 total work sets.

exercises.title: Calves
exercises.subtitle: Seated toe raises
exercises.body: Do 6 sets of 10 here after you are very warmed up. Continue to work in 20 of those tibialis raises in between each set. 6 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Lying leg curls
exercises.body: Once you are warmed up here, do 4 top end sets where you do 8 full reps, immediately followed by 10 bottom half partials. This should be such a strong pump to start your day off right. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Adductor machine
exercises.body: Take your time warming up here because I don't want you tearing anything. Once you find a good working weight give me 3 sets to failure, ideally in the 8-12 rep range. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Squat
exercises.body: After using the yoke bar last week, lets switch back to traditional barbell back squats but add a pause in the hole for a 2 count. Lower the weight ultra-controlled, pause, then fire up as explosively as possible. I want 4 working sets here of 8. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Leg press
exercises.body: After knocking out 1-2 feeder sets, get to a weight that you can pump 30 without stopping. Rest 2 minutes, add a plate per side and hit 30 again. Rest another 2 minutes, add a plate per side and gut out 30 any way you can get it. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Leg extension
exercises.body: Put on your working weight, fire the weight up, hold the contraction for a 2 count, then lower these at a snails pace (at least 5 seconds). 3 sets of 6 here and your legs should be toast. 3 total work set.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Dumbell stiff legged deadlift
exercises.body: Time to stretch everything out. 3 sets of 8 reps where you come all the way up and flex your glutes at the top. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Calves
exercises.subtitle: Standing raises
exercises.body: Back to heavy weight here this week. Remember, no bouncing out of the stretched position, we don't want to have your Achilles tendon dragging the floor. I want 6 sets of 10. 6 total work set.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Incline dumbell press
exercises.body: After a thorough warm-up and some feeder sets, I need 4 working sets of a weight that is going to challenge you for 12 reps. You will lower it controlled, pause the dumbells by your chest, drive up hard to contraction and FLEX your chest. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Incline press (barbell)
exercises.body: We have been cranking the reps on this exercise, time to lower the reps and add some weight to the bar. Do 3 sets of 6. The last set should be a very tough 6. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Pec-dec flyes
exercises.body: Do 4 hard sets of 10 here. Lower the weight, feel all those chest fibers stretch out, then FLEX at the contraction. 4 total work set.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Machine press
exercises.body: If you have access to the Decline Hammer Strength press and can put bands on this great. I want 4 hard sets of 8 here so that your chest is fully cramping going into training shoulders. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Shoulders
exercises.subtitle: Dumbell side laterals
exercises.body: Do 3 sets of 12 here. Bring the dumbells up to eye level. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Shoulders
exercises.subtitle: Heavy dumbbell partial side laterals
exercises.body: So whatever weight you used for your side laterals, double it for this exercise. Stand really tall, tilt your chin up and only do the bottom third of the side raise. 3 sets of 20 here. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Shoulders
exercises.subtitle: Reverse pec deck
exercises.body: Last exercise of the day, let's make sure we drive all the blood that is left into your rear delts. Do 3 sets of 30 here. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Dumbell rows
exercises.body: After 2 weeks of meadows rows, it's time for a mix up. We are going to work up to a ball busting heavy set of 8 reps here. After a couple warm ups and 3-4 feeder sets its time to pull some heavy iron. Only make 10 pound jumps so you get some good working sets in. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: D.Y. hammer row
exercises.body: This is a great exercise for lower lats. Push your hips back and drive your upper chest into the pad. Think about really getting your elbows back on these. Do 4 sets of 8 here. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Straight arm cable pullovers
exercises.body: Let's give your arms a break here and stretch those lats out. Using the rope or straight bar attachment and give me 4 sets of 12 reps. 4 total work set.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Seated cable row
exercises.body: Grab your favorite attachment here and try to really focus on only pulling with your lats to get the handle all the way to your belly button. Do not lose tension anywhere in the range of motion. Do 4 sets of 10. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Barbell hyperextensions
exercises.body: Come up and really squeeze your entire back. Do 4 sets of 8 and on your last set after you reach 8 reps, drop the bar and crank body weight reps to failure. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Abs
exercises.subtitle: Leg raise and rope crunch combo
exercises.body: A superset for abs, but changing out the second exercise. Do 4 rounds to failure here. 8 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Standing leg curl
exercises.body: Since this is single leg, really focus on a massive contraction. I want 4 sets of 10 each leg and if you don't have one of these machines, simply do the lying leg curl, one leg at a time. 6 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Machine leg press
exercises.body: Today lets hop on a cable/machine leg press and change our stance to mid-way up on the platform, but feet to the far outside of the plate. I want you to do 5 sets of 10 reps with 45 second rest periods. This may start off easy but should be brutal by set 5. 5 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Hack squat
exercises.body: On hack squat today I want you to lower the weight very low. Once in that position fire back up to 3/4 lockout and right back into the next. Give me one heavy set in the 8-10 rep range. Rest 3 minutes, cut the weight in half and give me an all out set of 20-30. 2 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Seated leg curls
exercises.body: All we are working here is the top half of the range of motion, so the stretch position. Put a pretty challenging weight on the machine, lock your body in stone and only using your hams move the leg of the machine to the half way point. 3 sets of 12 here please. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Biceps
exercises.subtitle: Cable curls
exercises.body: After a few warm ups let's do a pyramid for your work sets. The working rep ranges should be 20, 15, 12, 10. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Biceps
exercises.subtitle: E-Z bar preacher curls
exercises.body: You should be fully pumped at this point, so now onto my favorite bicep exercise. Lower the weight controlled, duck your head and bring the bar all the way up. Do 4 sets of 10. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Biceps
exercises.subtitle: Rope hammer curl
exercises.body: We have 4 sets here but I want your rest breaks SHORT, 25 seconds each. Select a medium weight and do as many reps as you can for all 4 sets. 4 total work set.

exercises.title: Triceps
exercises.subtitle: Dual rope pushdowns
exercises.body: What a great way to drive tons of blood into your triceps. I want you to find a great 15 rep weight and give me 4 sets with it. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Triceps
exercises.subtitle: Overhead rope extensions
exercises.body: Simply remove one of the ropes and flip around, with your back to the weight stack. I want to work your pumped triceps from the stretched position now. Same reps and set scheme, 4 by 15 reps. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Triceps
exercises.subtitle: Incline dumbbell skull crushers
exercises.body: Using a slight incline bench, let the dumbells sink low and really stretch your triceps out. Drive up to 3/4 lockout and then right into the next rep. 4 sets of 12 here should finish your arms off nicely. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Abs
exercises.subtitle: Machine crunches
exercises.body: Do 6 sets to failure here. 6 total work sets.

exercises.title: Calves
exercises.subtitle: Seated toe raises
exercises.body: Do 6 sets of 10 here after you are very warmed up. Continue to work in 20 of those tibialis raises in between each set. 6 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Lying leg curls
exercises.body: Once you are warmed up here, work up to a very hard 8 reps. On this last set, give me 8 reps, drop the weight do another 8 reps, drop the weight one last time and hit 8 more reps followed by 35 bottom half partials. You should be hobbling to the adductor machine after this. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Adductor machine
exercises.body: Take your time warming up here because I don't want you tearing anything. Once you find a good working weight do 3 sets of 8 here. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Leg press
exercises.body: Place your feet high on the platform to get some additional ham work and lets do sets of 8 till you can't get 8 anymore. Make sure you aren't making huge jumps in weight because I want you to get some good sets in here. We will call this 4 work sets. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Leg extensions
exercises.body: 3 sets of 20 reps of leg extensions where you really use a full range of motion. On your 4th set, complete 20 reps, then give me 20 more bottom half partials to really hammer your VMO (teardrop). 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Smith machine squats
exercises.body: With your legs completely full of blood let's get some deep squats in. Force your knees out and give me 4 sets of 6 reps here using a very slow decent, preferably 3 to 4 seconds. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Barbell stiff legged deadlift
exercises.body: Focus on pushing your hips back as you go down and only come up 3/4 of the way. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Calves
exercises.subtitle: Standing raises
exercises.body: Staying with heavy weight again this week. Remember, NO bouncing out of the stretched position, we don't want to have your Achilles tendon hanging off your lower leg. I want 6 sets of 10. 6 total work set.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Machine press
exercises.body: Work up in weight here until you miss 10 reps and then you are onto the next one. Machine press is a great first exercise and ideal for going into a hard free weight press. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Incline press (barbell)
exercises.body: After the machine press, these incline barbell presses should be flying off your chest. I want sets of 8 here, but pause every single rep 2 inches above your chest before firing the bar up hard and fast. There should be no grinding of reps, speed, speed, and more speed this week. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Flat dumbbell press
exercises.body: Do 4 hard sets of 8 with a squeeze at the contraction. 4 total work set.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Stretch pushups
exercises.body: If you have access to chains, throw a couple on your back for these, if not no big deal. Keep your chin up, get a deep stretch then press up and squeeze. 4 sets to failure should finish your chest off. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Shoulders
exercises.subtitle: Dumbell bent rear laterals
exercises.body: Do 3 sets of 15 here. Don't let your traps and lats do any of the work here. It will be a short range of motion but keep all the tension on the rear delt. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Shoulders
exercises.subtitle: Dumbell side laterals
exercises.body: Give me 3 sets of 15 but only take 20 second rest breaks. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Shoulders
exercises.subtitle: Reverse pec deck
exercises.body: Finishing up like last week but adding 5 more reps to the sets. Do 3 sets of 35 here. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Incline dumbell row
exercises.body: Lay face down on an incline bench. With a neutral grip on both dumbells drive your elbows up hard and fast. Bring the dumbells down till they are resting on the ground, then fire right back up. You should really be able to focus on rowing heavy since your lower back is fully supported. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: 1-arm barbell row
exercises.body: Time to get to work. Find a weight that is tough for 8 and give me 4 sets of 8. These should all be ball busting sets. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Dumbell pullovers
exercises.body: Get on a slight decline bench today, lift your chest and really get a good stretch on your lats. Do not turn this into a tricep extension. 4 sets of 10 reps with each set getting a little deeper. 4 total work set.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Rack pulls
exercises.body: After a couple feeder sets to find the perfect weight I want you to give me 3 sets of 8 reps. Really lock in your entire back and feel it from your traps to your glutes. Pull from mid shin. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Seated cable row
exercises.body: This week I want you to change up the attachment, but the exact same coaching cues. Really focus on only pulling with your lats to get the handle all the way to your belly button. Do not lose tension anywhere in the range of motion. Do 3 sets of 10. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Bodyweight hyperextensions
exercises.body: Do whatever it takes to get to 125 total reps. This may take 3-7 sets depending on how hard you push. We will call this 4 sets. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Abs
exercises.subtitle: Hanging leg raises
exercises.body: This is a ton of sets but focus on contraction and while you are in the stretch position try to do a vacuum with every rep. 8 sets to failure here. 8 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Leg extensions (occluded)
exercises.body: After the warm up is complete, wrap knee wraps around your upper thighs and lets do occluded leg extensions for 4 sets to failure. So use 30 second rest breaks between sets and do not remove the wraps till the 4th set is complete. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Reverse band squats
exercises.body: Attach average (orange or gray EliteFTS bands) to the top of your power rack and squat. This is a great exercise to really generate speed. I want 4 sets of 6-8 reps and to cut it off when you lose speed on these. If you cannot do reverse banding, that ok, just use speed reps with 55% of your 1 rep max. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Dumbell walking lunges
exercises.body: I want you to pick a medium weight and give me 40 total steps (20 each leg) and that's one set. I need 3 more of those for a total of 4 working sets. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Sissy squats
exercises.body: Give me 4 nice and slow sets of 8 here not hitting failure here with 1-minute rest breaks. If you have any knee issues, skip these. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Biceps and Triceps
exercises.subtitle: Cable curls and rope pressdowns (Superset)
exercises.body: After plenty of warm ups give me 4 sets of 15 on both exercises. 4 rounds for 8 total work sets.

exercises.title: Biceps and Triceps
exercises.subtitle: E-Z bar preacher curls and dumbell kickbacks (Superset)
exercises.body: Get right into your work sets and do 8 reps on the preacher curls followed by 8 reps on dumbbell kickbacks. 4 rounds for 8 total work sets.

exercises.title: Biceps and Triceps
exercises.subtitle: E-Z bar curls and decline e-z bar skull crushers (Superset)
exercises.body: Stand behind the decline bench and curl for sets of 12 then sit right down on the bench with the same bar and hit tricep extensions to failure. 3 rounds for 6 total work sets.

exercises.title: Biceps and Triceps
exercises.subtitle: Dumbell hammer curls and v-bar pushdowns (Superset)
exercises.body: Take a set of dumbells over to the cable station and do 10 hammer curls then right into sets of 20 on v-bar pushdowns. 3 rounds for 6 total work sets.

exercises.title: Abs
exercises.subtitle: V-ups
exercises.body: Do 6 sets to failure here. 6 total work sets.

exercises.title: Calves
exercises.subtitle: Leg press toe raises
exercises.body: Do 6 sets of 30 reps. These are going to be very painful, don't quit, get all 30 reps on all 6 sets. 6 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Banded stiff leg deadlifts
exercises.body: Do not rush the warm up process with these as we typically do them last on a leg day. But I want you to get after these when you are fresh and not on shaky legs. Hit a few sets without the band, then add the band and work your way up to a top end set. Do not make big jumps as I want you to get some good quality work sets in here. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Adductor machine
exercises.body: I'm taking the governor off you here today. Work your way up to a hard 10 reps. From there I want you to do 3 drops in weight. Even if you have to use your hands to self-spot. Go ape shit here on the adductor machine. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Banded leg press
exercises.body: Place your feet high on the platform to get some additional ham work and lets do sets of 8 till you can't get 8 anymore. Make sure you aren't making huge jumps in weight because I want you to get some good sets in here. We will call this 4 work sets. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Hack squat
exercises.body: We are going to really push hard on the hack squat today. As we build weight, the reps lower but the negative time increases. We need 4 sets here. Example: 2 plates/15 reps (2 second negative), 3 plates/12 reps (3 second negative), 4 plates/10 reps (4 second negative), 5 plates/8 reps (5 second negative). 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Bulgarian split squats
exercises.body: No death set here today, but that doesn't mean I want this to be easy. Really push yourself and work up to a heavy set. Do sets of 8 working up to a weight that kinda scares you and go bananas! 4 total work set.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Lying leg curl
exercises.body: To finish off your legs today I want 4 sets of 12 done rest-pause style. 4 total work set.

exercises.title: Calves
exercises.subtitle: Seated calve raises
exercises.body: Really move some weight here. As always do not rush the stretch portion of the rep because that's where the growth happens. I want 4 sets of 10. 4 total work set.

exercises.title: Calves
exercises.subtitle: Standing raises
exercises.body: After your heavy seated raises, these high-rep standing will take your pump to the next level. I want 4 sets of 20. 4 total work set.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Flat dumbell press
exercises.body: Work up in weight here until you miss 8 reps. Lock into these and only let your chest do the work. Drive up to 3/4 lockout. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Incline press (barbell)
exercises.body: Last week we did these with a pause, this week we are going to work up to a drop set. Do sets of 6 till you reach a weight that would be tough 8. Drop set example: 275 lbs x 8 -> 225 x 6 -> 185 x 10. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Neutral grip machine press
exercises.body: Sink these as deep as your shoulders allow. Open your chest up, then press into a hard contraction. 4 total sets of 10 reps.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Incline dumbbell flyes
exercises.body: Do 4 hard sets of 8 with a squeeze at the contraction. Feel free to do these either pronated or palms facing, whichever you feel more in your upper chest. 4 total work set.

exercises.title: Chest
exercises.subtitle: Stretch pushups
exercises.body: Same finisher as last week for chest. Keep your chin up, get a deep stretch then press up and squeeze. 3 sets to failure should finish your chest off. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Shoulders
exercises.subtitle: Reverse pec deck
exercises.body: Find a good working weight and give me 4 sets of 15 reps with a 1 second squeeze at the contraction. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Shoulders
exercises.subtitle: Seated dumbell side laterals
exercises.body: Sit up tall and raise these up to 10 and 2 O'clock. Not only will this get your side delt, but also your front. 4 sets of 12 here should have you looking wide. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Shoulders
exercises.subtitle: Machine shoulder press
exercises.body: Nail 3 sets of 10 on your favorite shoulder press machine. Could be a Hammer strength, cable or Smith machine. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: D-handle seated cable row
exercises.body: We have been finishing with these for our rowing but start here today. One singular goal, drive as much blood into your lats as possible. Give me 4 sets of 10. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: 1-arm barbell row
exercises.body: Keeping this in here from last week. Find a weight that is tough for 8 and give me 4 sets of 8. These should all be ball busting sets. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Meadows rows
exercises.body: Let's move right into a different hand position on the same place. Use the same weight you used for the 1-arm barbell row and give me 4 sets of 8. These should also be ball busting. 4 total work set.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Dumbell pullovers
exercises.body: I want to give your arms a break after 3 straight rowing movements. 4 sets of 12 reps here. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Assisted pull-ups
exercises.body: Use a wider overhand grip and really focus on the stretch on these. Only come up 3/4 of the way, lower in a slow 3 count, pause in the bottom to feel your lats stretch out, then only using your lats, drive up. 4 sets of 10 here. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Back
exercises.subtitle: Banded hyperextensions
exercises.body: Use 2 red bands here today and give me 4 sets to failure. On the last set do failure with the bands and then bodyweight to failure. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Abs
exercises.subtitle: Hanging leg raises and rope crunches
exercises.body: Do 4 rounds here for a total of 8 sets. 8 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Seated leg curls
exercises.body: After the warm up is complete, let's crank hard on those hamstrings. Make every single rep perfect. Big stretch, crazy contraction, and with each set go heavier than the previous. I want sets in the 8-12 range please. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Glute machine
exercises.body: Don't think lightly of this machine, go to work on it and your squats will feel great afterwards. 4 sets of 10 reps. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Reverse band squats
exercises.body: Same as last week since we attacked hypers hard and your low back may need a little break. Attach average orange or gray EliteFTS bands to the top of your power rack and squat. I want 4 sets of 6-8 reps and to cut it off when you lose speed on these. 4 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Single-leg leg press
exercises.body: Sink these deep and drive your knee outside of your rib cage. 4 sets of 10 on each leg should be really hard after the squats. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Legs
exercises.subtitle: Ham killers
exercises.body: Do these or feel free to use a GHR, whichever makes your hams hurt the worst. Shoot your hips forward, do NOT use your lower back and really squeeze your hamstrings hard. 3 sets of 8-10 will be a perfect way to finish. 3 total work sets.

exercises.title: Triceps and Biceps
exercises.subtitle: Straight bar pressdown and dumbell curls (Superset)
exercises.body: After plenty of warm ups give me 4 sets of 12 on the pressdowns and then 8 reps on the dumbell curls, but use 3 second negatives and your palms up the entire time on the curls. 4 rounds for 8 total work sets.

exercises.title: Triceps and Biceps
exercises.subtitle: Rope pressdowns and E-Z bar preacher curls (Superset)
exercises.body: Another cable movement and free weight bicep exercise. For the pressdowns do 12 reps and for the preacher curls do 10 reps. 4 rounds for 8 total work sets.

exercises.title: Triceps and Biceps
exercises.subtitle: E-z bar skull crushers and dumbbell hammer curls (Superset)
exercises.body: After two cable movements, your tris should be ready and warmed up for the skull crushers. I want you to do sets of 10 here, then stand right up, grab some dumbells and do cross-body hammer curls for 10 reps as well. 4 rounds for 8 total work sets.

exercises.title: Triceps and Biceps
exercises.subtitle: Dip Machine and e-z bar reverse curls (Superset)
exercises.body: Feel free to use a machine or benches for your dips today. I want sets of 15 here and then sets of 15 on the reverse curls too. Your arms should be massively pumped at this point. 4 rounds for 8 total work sets.

exercises.title: Abs
exercises.subtitle: V-ups and machine crunches
exercises.body: Do 4 rounds of 15 on each exercise here today. 8 total work sets.

exercises.title: Calves
exercises.subtitle: Standing calf raises
exercises.body: I want 8 sets of 10 with 20 second rest breaks......burn baby burn. 8 total work sets.
